function keys(input: { a: number } | null | undefined) {
  for (const key in input) console.log(key);
}
function genericKeys<T>(input: T) {
  for (const key in input) console.log(key, input[key]);
}
function branded(text: string & { readonly brand: "tag" }) {
  for (const key in text) console.log(key);
}
keys({ a: 1 });
keys(undefined);
genericKeys({ b: 2 });
branded("a" as string & { readonly brand: "tag" } as any);
